benchmark_metadata.name: LEXORA Verified Legal Intelligence Benchmark
benchmark_metadata.phase: Phase 13: Pilot Validation, Legal Accuracy Improvement & Benchmark Expansion
benchmark_metadata.dataset_limitations: Benchmark covers landmark Constitution Bench decisions, Division Bench rulings, and major commercial statutes. Ongoing pilot expansion tracks state-specific High Court splits and tribunal decrees.

discrepancy_explanation.root_cause: Phase 10 overall report displayed 85.79% Claim Support and 90.44% Citation Support by computing a macro-average over all 61 queries, where 6 negative-control abstention queries had 0 required claims and 0 citations (conventionally evaluated as 1.0 ratio). On genuine answerable queries (N=55), Macro Claim Support is 84.24% and Micro Claim Support is 84.13% (159/189 claims). Similarly, Citation Support on answerable queries is Macro 89.39% and Micro 87.23% (82/94 citations). The 83.20% figure was the un-optimized Phase 9 baseline macro score prior to tokenization improvements.
discrepancy_explanation.convention_rule: Both views are now explicitly separated: Answerable Targets (N=55) vs Global Macro (N=61).
